doctrine: SNIPED operator photography mastery via Gemini AI image critique + color physics education. Framework: 8-criterion image analysis (composition/lighting/color/pose/depth/edit/emotional weight/uniqueness). Strengths locked: Color palette (disciplined blocking), Edit/Grading (clinical polished), Subject pose (chin forward-down, hands tasked). Weaknesses: Depth/dimensionality (subjects melt into flat backgrounds), Emotional/narrative weight (rehearsed poses vs. in-between authenticity). Elite grid formula: Hard-flash warm glamour (9/10 lighting + 8/10 color + 8/10 pose) OR Surreal geometric AI (10/10 generation + 5/10 emotion) OR Hyper-luminous celebrity (10/10 edit + 9/10 depth). SNIPED PRESTIGE BASE: Tone curve S with lifted blacks (matte punch); Orange Hue +5, Saturation -10, Luminance +15 (skin glow); Blue Primary +30-40 (warm richness). Engineered Grit: Global grain 15/20/50 (skin glue); Atmospheric blur 15-20; Local background grain 45/25/50 (tactile canvas forces eye to sharp face). Color Matrices: Expansive (cool background recedes, warm subject pops 3D) vs. Claustrophobic (warm on warm = flat graphic 2D tension). Black wardrobe math: Power Matrices (Blood Red/Crimsion = aggressive, Emerald/Teal = luxury moody, Charcoal/Void = cinematic void). Spill mask physics: Subject mask + Linear Gradient + Luminance Range intersection (protects deep blacks, applies bounce only to midtones/highlights). Intentional Slice: Never crop at joints; slice mid-limb (mid-bicep, mid-thigh, mid-forearm) to anchor subject as monumental graphic element. Three pillars of digital depth: (1) Atmospheric depth via Lens Blur ~15-20, (2) Luminance depth via Linear Gradient -0.50 exposure floor anchor, (3) Color depth via warm/cool temperature recession rules. Evoto pipeline limits: Do NOT use for primary background color replacement (haloing, clipping, flat physics). Lightroom handles color block/depth/grit. Evoto handles final 5% (frequency separation, blemishes, flyaways). If forced Evoto replacement: max 85% opacity, luminosity match to original, edge feathering +10-15, pre-clean chromatic aberration in Lightroom Optics. Production workflow: (1) Stress-test matrices across wardrobe colors (warm/cool), lighting conditions (bright/moody), skin tones. (2) Global Sniped Prestige baseline first. (3) Background mask with Expansive/Claustrophobic/Power matrix. (4) Light fall-off gradient. (5) Environmental spill with Luminance Range protection. (6) Intentional slice crop. (7) 16-bit TIFF to Evoto for skin polish. Signature identity: Highly-polished, disciplined monochromatic color blocking + flawless retouching + severe confident posing to create bold graphic impact. Anti-pattern: Plastic mask effect (gritty clothes, smooth plastic face). Solution: Lightroom-native masking, global+local grain split, preserve pore-level texture through Evoto AI respect for grain structure.
